CustomField.description: Refers to the limit of the query in the start method of DashboardRefreshLoginHistoryBatch. Defaults to no limit if not specified. Set a limit (you can start with 500,000 and keep lowering it if errors persist) if we're getting a Visualforce Remoting Exception: String length exceeds maximum: 6000000 on the frontend
